invariants: every typed key reaches the focused terminal only: a step that types changes the screen hash of that terminal and of no other
the output of seq 1 60 is in order, and scrolling changes no terminal's state
the focus stays in the launch terminal from launched to split-right, moves to the new pane with split-right and back with focus-left
paste runs the copied line once, in the new pane only
resize changes the split's ratios and the launch terminal's columns, and leaves its output and the focus as they were
the interrupt ends sleep 30 at once: the launch terminal shows a new prompt, and no terminal exits (exitCode stays null)
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the viewport's scroll offset: no facet reads it yet (p15-oracle-246)
the pasteboard's text: no facet reads it, and copy writes the host's general pasteboard
a selection made with the pointer, and copy mode (toggleTerminalCopyMode)
a window resize: the case resizes a split
